name: Qdrant
description: A vector database for similarity search: collections of embeddings written and queried over HTTP or gRPC, with a web dashboard of its own. Everything it stores lives in one directory on the data volume.

access.note: Qdrant serves its own dashboard at /dashboard, and opening it asks for one thing: an API key. Paste the generated key from the Variables tab — there is no account name, that key is the whole credential. Programs send the same key as an "api-key" header (or an "Authorization: Bearer <key>" one) on every call. Without it /collections, /telemetry, /metrics and /cluster all answer 401; only /healthz, /livez, /readyz and the root path stay open, and the root path returns nothing but the version string.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; applications on this host reach it over the Docker network without one. Qdrant builds no absolute URLs, so nothing else here changes when it is set.

update.notes: Qdrant reads the storage directory a previous patch release wrote; downgrading across a minor version does not.
